description: Comptage du trafic Bordeaux Métropole is a series of datasets listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Bordeaux Métropole a installé un réseau de capteurs pour évaluer l'état de la circulation sur son territoire. Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per month, area, counter or year), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are automobile, débit, véhicule, poids lourds, routier, trafic. The portal shows 408 records. The portal shows 2022-03-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
